0022600101.text: The Warriors (0-1, 3rd in the Pacific and 13th in the West) host the Grizzlies (1-0, 2nd in the Southwest and 6th in the West) in their second game of the season, after a road loss. Golden State is without Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), while Memphis is missing Cedric Coward (wrist sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Warriors won all three meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently a 133-112 win in Memphis on February 25, 2026.
